parent_protocol.reason_for_new_version: The teacher's fixed-antigen different-antibody question exposed that v1 tested only the reciprocal fixed-antibody direction and that total contact scores could contain unary propensity shortcuts.

project.name: FrameContact
project.title: Geometry-aware Partner-specific Antibody-Antigen Modeling under Structural Novelty
project.confirmatory_claim: On structurally novel antigens, the model changes its epitope hypothesis with antibody identity and ranks the cognate antibody above matched non-cognate antibodies using jointly conditioned residue-pair evidence rather than monomer propensity.

evidence_boundary_at_freeze.prohibited_claim: No existing residue-only result establishes antibody-specific epitope prediction or cognate-partner discrimination.

hypothesis.primary: For the same antigen, the cognate antibody receives a higher interaction-only compatibility score than 31 metadata-matched non-cognate antibodies.
hypothesis.reciprocal: For the same antibody, the cognate antigen receives a higher interaction-only compatibility score than 31 metadata-matched non-cognate antigens.
hypothesis.mechanistic: Independent local-frame self-attention improves monomer features; explicit contact prediction creates an alignment-free pair representation that gates cross-chain information flow.
hypothesis.null: Cognate and matched non-cognate partners have equal expected interaction-only compatibility after structural-cluster weighting.

data.development_source: Authenticated SAbDab2 structures and exact residue-pair labels

split.name: antigen_structure_novel_v1
hard_constraints: zero exact antigen sequence overlap across roles
zero exact focal antibody sequence overlap across roles
zero PDB biological assembly overlap across roles
no test role used for architecture, checkpoint, calibration, threshold, or seed selection

reciprocal_partner_panel.selection_time: before fitting from identifiers and task-label-free metadata

primary_endpoint.name: fixed_antigen_cognate_antibody_interaction_margin
primary_endpoint.pair_score: mean sigmoid of the largest max(1,ceil(0.01*candidate_pair_count)) pair-interaction logits, explicitly excluding antibody unary, antigen unary, and global contact bias
primary_endpoint.estimand: score(cognate antibody, fixed antigen) minus mean score of 31 frozen wrong antibodies
primary_endpoint.success_rule: the two-sided 95% bootstrap lower bound is greater than zero

required_reciprocal_endpoint.name: fixed_antibody_cognate_antigen_interaction_margin
required_reciprocal_endpoint.success_rule: reported with a 10000-replicate antibody-cluster bootstrap; it cannot replace a failed primary fixed-antigen endpoint

required: marginal-only score using antibody and antigen unary terms
shortcut_controls.interpretation: A positive total-contact margin with a non-positive interaction-only margin is a shortcut failure.

architecture_matrix: WALLE official implementation on its native AsEP task
EpiFormer official implementation on its native AsEP task
GVP or EGNN matched-capacity structure baseline

training_objective.contact: class-balanced BCE on authenticated cognate residue-pair labels
training_objective.specificity: mean softplus ranking loss over both reciprocal counterfactual directions
training_objective.wrong_pair_rule: wrong pairs are ranking examples and are never assigned fabricated all-zero contact matrices

model_selection.checkpoint_rule: maximize the minimum of the two validation cluster-weighted directional margins; break ties within 0.0001 by validation mean per-complex contact AUPRC, then earlier epoch
model_selection.reporting: all seeds plus the frozen five-seed ensemble

mechanism: attention entropy by layer and head
cross-attention gate by direction and layer

external_evaluation.frozen_test: opened once only after checkpoints, panels, scorer, thresholds, and receipts are frozen
external_evaluation.asep: external antibody-specific epitope benchmark; never tune on its test role
external_evaluation.chimera: canonical epitope-conditioned CDR sequence-structure co-design is a separate downstream task

failure_rules: Antigen-only epitope AUPRC cannot establish antibody specificity.
Attention weights are not contacts unless the contact head is scored against exact pair labels.
A one-seed or development-only gain cannot support the confirmatory claim.
Recent preprints are inspiration and external baselines, not evidence for FrameContact until reproduced under the frozen split.
